benefit_text: AI can remove nearly all misinformation online.
consequence_text: One company decides what counts as true.

benefit_text: An AI tutor gives every student unlimited personal help.
consequence_text: It reports signs of cheating or disengagement to teachers.

benefit_text: AI can predict serious crimes before they happen.
consequence_text: People may be restricted for something they have not done.

benefit_text: AI makes hiring almost free of human bias.
consequence_text: No person can explain or appeal its final decisions.

benefit_text: Your AI assistant always knows the best decision for you.
consequence_text: Following its advice slowly weakens your own judgement.

benefit_text: AI can recreate the voice and style of any historical figure for education.
consequence_text: Nobody can reliably tell authentic recordings from generated ones.

benefit_text: AI gives everyone a perfectly personalised news feed.
consequence_text: You rarely encounter ideas it thinks you will dislike.

benefit_text: AI can write every routine school assignment instantly.
consequence_text: Schools replace written homework with constant live assessment.

benefit_text: AI can translate every conversation perfectly in real time.
consequence_text: Fewer people choose to learn other languages and cultures deeply.

benefit_text: AI can detect when someone online is lying with 95% accuracy.
consequence_text: Every video call and message must be analysed.

benefit_text: Your city can find missing people within minutes.
consequence_text: Public cameras identify and track everyone at all times.

benefit_text: Schools can stop most bullying before it escalates.
consequence_text: Software continuously scans every student message on school devices.

benefit_text: Apps become free and contain no advertising.
consequence_text: They can build detailed profiles from everything you do.

benefit_text: A health system warns you years before many illnesses appear.
consequence_text: It combines your medical, shopping and movement data.

benefit_text: You never need another password.
consequence_text: Your face becomes the key to nearly every service.

benefit_text: Police solve far more serious crimes.
consequence_text: Everyone must submit a DNA sample to a national database.

benefit_text: Your parents can always confirm that you are safe.
consequence_text: They can see your exact location until you turn eighteen.

benefit_text: Online harassment becomes much easier to stop.
consequence_text: Every social-media account must be linked to a verified identity.

benefit_text: A smart home automatically saves energy and prevents accidents.
consequence_text: It records patterns of activity in every room.

benefit_text: Personal data can help researchers solve major public problems.
consequence_text: You cannot choose which approved studies use your data.

benefit_text: Everyone receives enough money for basic living costs.
consequence_text: Some public services and tax benefits are reduced to fund it.

benefit_text: No news organisation can knowingly publish false claims.
consequence_text: A government-appointed body decides when a claim crosses the line.

benefit_text: Voting becomes quick and accessible from any phone.
consequence_text: The system cannot provide a paper ballot for independent recounts.

benefit_text: Public transport becomes free for everyone.
consequence_text: City taxes rise even for people who never use it.

benefit_text: Every student receives the same educational resources.
consequence_text: Schools cannot spend extra money raised by their own communities.

benefit_text: Nobody can inherit more than a set amount of wealth.
consequence_text: Families lose the right to pass on everything they built.

benefit_text: Public debates become calmer and more factual.
consequence_text: Anonymous political speech is banned.

benefit_text: All essential government services work through one simple app.
consequence_text: Losing access to the app can lock you out of daily life.

benefit_text: Every citizen must complete one year of community service.
consequence_text: People lose one year of personal choice over study or work.

benefit_text: Algorithms distribute public funding using consistent rules.
consequence_text: Elected representatives can no longer make exceptions for unusual cases.

benefit_text: Doctors can prevent many inherited diseases before birth.
consequence_text: The same technology could be used to select non-medical traits.

benefit_text: Organ transplants never have waiting lists.
consequence_text: Animal organs are genetically modified and raised for human use.

benefit_text: A brain implant restores memory lost through illness.
consequence_text: The company that made it can send required software updates.

benefit_text: Medicine is priced low enough for everyone to afford.
consequence_text: Drug companies receive much less reward for successful discoveries.

benefit_text: A national system gives treatment first to those most likely to recover.
consequence_text: Age and disability influence a person’s priority score.

benefit_text: Schools can identify mental-health concerns much earlier.
consequence_text: Students must complete regular private wellbeing screenings.

benefit_text: Wearable devices alert emergency services before a medical crisis.
consequence_text: Your health data is continuously sent to a central system.

benefit_text: Scientists can test new treatments much faster using digital human models.
consequence_text: Some rare biological reactions may be missed.

benefit_text: Every patient receives the same evidence-based treatment.
consequence_text: Doctors have less freedom to rely on judgement in unusual cases.

benefit_text: A pill can safely reduce the need for sleep by half.
consequence_text: School and work schedules may expand because people can stay awake longer.

benefit_text: Your country reaches zero transport emissions in five years.
consequence_text: Most private petrol cars are banned from city centres.

benefit_text: Air travel becomes carbon neutral.
consequence_text: Every passenger’s yearly flights are strictly limited.

benefit_text: Single-use packaging almost disappears.
consequence_text: Food and everyday products become noticeably more expensive.

benefit_text: Large forests are permanently protected.
consequence_text: Nearby towns lose access to land that supports many local jobs.

benefit_text: Homes waste almost no energy.
consequence_text: Governments can require costly upgrades when houses are sold.

benefit_text: Clean energy becomes extremely cheap.
consequence_text: Large wind and solar projects may be built near communities that oppose them.

benefit_text: Fishing populations fully recover.
consequence_text: Commercial fishing is paused for several years.

benefit_text: Your city removes most traffic and pollution.
consequence_text: Road space is taken from cars and given to buses and bicycles.

benefit_text: Companies must repair all environmental damage they cause.
consequence_text: Prices rise and some businesses move overseas.

benefit_text: Scientists can cool the planet using atmospheric technology.
consequence_text: Stopping the system suddenly could cause rapid climate change.

benefit_text: A single digital ID makes every online service simple.
consequence_text: One security failure could expose your entire digital life.

benefit_text: You can instantly recover anything deleted from your devices.
consequence_text: Nothing you create is ever fully erased.

benefit_text: Deepfakes disappear from major platforms.
consequence_text: Every uploaded image and video must pass an authenticity check.

benefit_text: Robots complete all dangerous and exhausting jobs.
consequence_text: Millions of workers must change careers within a few years.

benefit_text: Your phone battery lasts for a month.
consequence_text: The battery cannot be replaced or recycled safely.

benefit_text: Internet access becomes a free public service.
consequence_text: The network blocks content that an independent board labels harmful.

benefit_text: Smart glasses give useful information about everything you see.
consequence_text: People around you cannot know when they are being analysed.

benefit_text: A global system permanently proves who created every digital work.
consequence_text: Anonymous creation online becomes nearly impossible.

benefit_text: All devices use one perfectly compatible system.
consequence_text: A single organisation controls the standard and its updates.

benefit_text: Children are protected from nearly all harmful online content.
consequence_text: Age verification is required to access most websites.

benefit_text: Schools can guarantee a distraction-free learning day.
consequence_text: Student phones are locked by software during school hours.

benefit_text: People are protected from manipulative recommendation systems.
consequence_text: Users cannot turn on unlimited personalised feeds.

benefit_text: Every worker receives at least four weeks of paid leave.
consequence_text: People cannot choose to trade that leave for extra pay.

benefit_text: Public spaces become safer and quieter at night.
consequence_text: A strict youth curfew applies even to those causing no problems.

benefit_text: Students can choose almost every subject they study.
consequence_text: They may graduate without learning some shared basic knowledge.

benefit_text: People can move and work freely between all countries.
consequence_text: Individual countries lose control over who can settle there.

benefit_text: Social platforms must show every legal opinion equally.
consequence_text: Users cannot fully filter ideas they find offensive or upsetting.

benefit_text: Workers can choose exactly when and where they work.
consequence_text: Teams have fewer shared hours for fast decisions.

benefit_text: Citizens can directly vote on every major law.
consequence_text: Complex decisions are made through short public campaigns.

benefit_text: Students can anonymously review every teacher.
consequence_text: Reviews may affect careers even when claims cannot be verified.

benefit_text: University places are divided equally among all regions.
consequence_text: Some applicants with higher grades lose places.

benefit_text: Every team receives the same budget.
consequence_text: Successful teams cannot keep the extra money they earn.

benefit_text: School assessment focuses only on demonstrated skill.
consequence_text: Effort and improvement do not affect the final grade.

benefit_text: An exam gives extra time to anyone who requests it.
consequence_text: The school does not check whether students need the support.

benefit_text: All employees’ salaries are public inside their company.
consequence_text: Personal financial information becomes workplace knowledge.

benefit_text: No student can pay for private tutoring.
consequence_text: Family wealth has less effect, but students lose extra learning choices.

benefit_text: A lottery decides between equally qualified applicants.
consequence_text: Years of small differences in effort no longer affect the outcome.

benefit_text: Everyone pays the same percentage of income in tax.
consequence_text: Low-income families feel each dollar of tax more strongly.

benefit_text: School sports teams guarantee equal playing time.
consequence_text: The strongest lineup cannot stay on during close matches.

benefit_text: Automated marking applies exactly the same rules to every essay.
consequence_text: Original ideas outside its pattern may receive lower scores.

benefit_text: A permanent city on Mars gives humanity a second home.
consequence_text: The same money could solve urgent problems on Earth.

benefit_text: People can preserve a complete digital copy of their memories.
consequence_text: A company controls access to that copy after they die.

benefit_text: Driverless vehicles prevent nearly all road crashes.
consequence_text: People are no longer allowed to drive on public roads.

benefit_text: Machines produce almost everything people need.
consequence_text: Paid employment stops being a central part of many lives.

benefit_text: Cities can predict and prevent most infrastructure failures.
consequence_text: Every movement through the city contributes to the prediction system.

benefit_text: Virtual worlds feel as convincing as physical ones.
consequence_text: Many people choose to spend most of their free time inside them.

benefit_text: Human lifespan increases greatly through safe medicine.
consequence_text: Younger generations wait much longer for leadership and resources.

benefit_text: Weather can be controlled to prevent droughts.
consequence_text: Changing rain in one region may reduce it somewhere else.

benefit_text: A global council can act quickly on worldwide emergencies.
consequence_text: Countries must follow some decisions their citizens opposed.

benefit_text: People can permanently remove painful memories.
consequence_text: Those experiences no longer guide their future decisions.

benefit_text: Asteroid mining provides abundant rare materials.
consequence_text: Private companies can own resources taken from space.

benefit_text: A telescope can detect signs of distant intelligent life.
consequence_text: Its signal reveals Earth’s location at the same time.

benefit_text: Humans build the first settlement on another world.
consequence_text: The first settlers accept that rescue may not always be possible.

benefit_text: Satellites provide free internet everywhere on Earth.
consequence_text: Night skies become crowded with moving lights.

benefit_text: Public transport arrives within five minutes everywhere.
consequence_text: Private cars pay a high fee to enter busy areas.

benefit_text: Roads become safer through automatic speed control.
consequence_text: Vehicles physically cannot exceed the detected limit.

benefit_text: Flights become faster than ever.
consequence_text: Sonic noise affects communities along the routes.

benefit_text: Every journey uses one simple payment account.
consequence_text: The provider can see a complete record of where you travel.

benefit_text: Scientific data must be freely available to everyone.
consequence_text: Companies have less reason to pay for expensive research.

benefit_text: Students can see exactly how school algorithms evaluate them.
consequence_text: People may learn how to game the system instead of improving.
